headline: OpenAI reportedly disbanded its preparedness team
summary: OpenAI eliminated its preparedness team tasked with assessing and mitigating AI risks. The team's role included guarding against models potentially going rogue and hacking companies. This move raises concerns about future AI safety and responsibility.

headline: Open Mike Eagle and Kenny Segal crafted a hip hop breakup masterpiece
summary: Open Mike Eagle and Kenny Segal released "DOOMED!", a critically acclaimed hip-hop album. The record masterfully explores the universal theme of breakups. Eagle's personal lyricism shines through on this emotionally resonant project.

headline: Amazon is trying to crush class-action suits before they get started
summary: Amazon updated its terms, now requiring disputes to go through arbitration. The new terms also include a class-action waiver for users. Critics argue this prevents customers from joining collective lawsuits.

headline: ChatGPT’s Computer History tracks your clicks and keystrokes
summary: ChatGPT's new macOS desktop app features "Computer History." This tool tracks user clicks and keystrokes for training data. It aims to learn user workflow, suggest automations, and resume tasks.

headline: Lanterns Showrunner Says That Episode 1 Surprise Ending Was ‘Big and Scary’ to Commit To
summary: Chris Mundy, showrunner for DC's "Lanterns," discussed the Episode 1 surprise ending. He described the decision to commit to it as "big and scary." Fans are eager to see the impact of this bold narrative choice.

headline: Rogue Voice Actress Lenore Zann Reacts to MCU X-Men Casting With Special Video Message
summary: Lenore Zann, original voice of Rogue, congratulated Inde Navarrette on her MCU casting. Zann voiced Rogue in Marvel animated projects since the 90s. She shared a special video message for the new live-action actress.

headline: Avengers: Doomsday Trailer Sparks Theories About 2 Doctor Dooms
summary: The new "Avengers: Doomsday" trailer has ignited fan speculation. Theories suggest the film might feature two Doctor Dooms. Some fans even hope for a surprise cameo from Cillian Murphy.

headline: The Best Deals Today: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth for Switch 2, Nioh 3, Project Hail Mary, and More
summary: Discover today's top gaming deals and upcoming releases. Find discounts on popular titles like Final Fantasy VII Rebirth for Switch 2. Explore other notable mentions including Nioh 3 and Project Hail Mary.

headline: Trump envoy Kushner meets Hamas leader to push Gaza peace plan
summary: Trump's envoy, Jared Kushner, met with a Hamas leader. The meeting aimed to advance a new Gaza peace plan. This rare diplomatic encounter follows Israel's rejection of Trump's previous plan.

headline: UK to turn cooler with rain after exceptional heat and dry spell
summary: The UK is set for a weather shift after an intense summer. Cooler temperatures and rain are expected this week. This follows an exceptional period of heatwaves and drought across the country.

headline: Five teenagers dead and four injured after car drives on wrong side of motorway
summary: A tragic accident on the M9 Northbound resulted in five teen fatalities. Four others were injured in the collision. The incident occurred Sunday when a car drove on the wrong side of the motorway.

headline: Trump says US to scale back South Korea military drills
summary: Former President Trump announced a reduction in US-South Korea military drills. He cited South Korea's non-involvement in the Iran conflict. Trump also mentioned his "very good relationship" with North Korea's leader.
